nodes.label: Enter Key Icon
nodes.description: Icon depicting the Enter/Return key, showing a downward-then-leftward arrow inside a key outline. Represents the action of submitting input, confirming a search, or executing a command in the E-Tipitaka UI.

nodes.label: Submit/Confirm Action
nodes.rationale: The Enter key icon visually communicates to users that pressing Enter triggers submission, typically used to execute a search query in E-Tipitaka's search interface.

nodes.label: Keyboard Shortcut Hint
nodes.rationale: Used as a UI hint or tooltip indicator to inform users which keyboard key activates a function, improving discoverability of keyboard shortcuts.
